nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

**The inputs start bypassed (purple), so Text to image runs right away.** Pick a **Mode**, un-bypass (select + Ctrl+B) only the inputs it uses and load your files. **Keep every input you are not using bypassed**: ComfyUI checks the file of every active loader before a run, also in modes that never read it.

| Mode | Uses | Turbo, RTX 3060 |
|---|---|---|
| Text to image | prompt | 2K: 57 s |
| Edit (your images) | Image 1 (+ 2, 3 optional; write <Picture 1> etc. in the prompt) | 1K: 22 s |
| ControlNet: pose | Control image (a person; the pose is read from it) | 1 MP: 24 s |
| ControlNet: depth | Control image (any scene) | 1 MP: 27 s |
| ControlNet: edges (canny) | Control image (lines, text, products) | 1 MP: 23 s |

If the mode needs Image 1 or the Control image and it is still bypassed, the run stops at the "Needs ..." node instead of quietly making a text-to-image.

**Turbo on** = the official Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo model, 8 steps. **Turbo off** = the base model at "Steps without Turbo" (40) with Comfy Kitchen attention: 2K takes 4:07.
**Size**: megapixels + aspect ratio (4 MP = 2048x2048, Qwen 2.1's native 2K). Edit uses its own resolution budget (1024 = about 1 MP; 2048 took 11 min on the 3060 in my benchmark).
**ControlNet strength**: 1.0 = follow the map closely, lower = looser. **ControlNet megapixels** (1): the ControlNet modes use your control image's own shape at this size. At 4 MP (2K) the Fun ControlNet broke in my runs: pose filled the background with scribbles and depth came back as a coloured depth map. At 1 MP both came out clean.
Only want Text to image? ComfyUI still checks every loader: point the red ControlNet / pose / depth loaders at any file you have. They never load unless you pick a ControlNet mode.

Double-click the node to see every step. **Colours inside the node:** 🟦 load models · 🟩 your input (pose, face, frames) · 🟪 prompt + conditioning · 🟧 sampling · 🟨 decode + video · ⬛ settings + switches · 🟦‍ cyan = extras (side by side)

nodes.title: Downloads
widgets_values:
## Downloads - put each file in the ComfyUI folder shown

Click a file name to download it. Put it in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`).

**[Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| Turbo on (8 steps) | `diffusion_models/` | [qwen_image_2.1_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 7.3 GB |
| Turbo off (base) | `diffusion_models/` | [qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 7.3 GB |
| all modes | `text_encoders/` | [qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 9.4 GB |
| all modes | `vae/` | [qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors) | 0.7 GB |
| ControlNet modes | `model_patches/` | [qwen_image_2.1_fun_controlnet_union_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/model_patches/qwen_image_2.1_fun_controlnet_union_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 3.8 GB |

**[Comfy-Org/SDPose](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/SDPose)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| ControlNet: pose | `checkpoints/` | [sdpose_wholebody_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/SDPose/resolve/main/checkpoints/sdpose_wholebody_fp16.safetensors) | 1.9 GB |
| ControlNet: pose | `diffusion_models/` | [rt_detr_v4-x-hgnet_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/SDPose/resolve/main/diffusion_models/rt_detr_v4-x-hgnet_fp16.safetensors) | 0.1 GB |

**[Comfy-Org/lotus](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/lotus)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| ControlNet: depth | `diffusion_models/` | [lotus-depth-d-v1-1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/lotus/resolve/main/lotus-depth-d-v1-1.safetensors) | 1.7 GB |

**[stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-mse-original](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-mse-original)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| ControlNet: depth | `vae/` | [vae-ft-mse-840000-ema-pruned.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-mse-original/resolve/main/vae-ft-mse-840000-ema-pruned.safetensors) | 0.3 GB |

_Tested on: RTX 3060 12 GB · 32 GB RAM · ComfyUI 0.39.2._

No custom nodes: core ComfyUI **0.38 or newer** (Qwen Image 2.1 Fun ControlNet support). Qwen Image 2.1 + Turbo: Qwen Research License (non-commercial).
